section1.title: The Library for Safety Professionals
section1.content:
Smart JSA Bridge brings actual JSA templates, previously scattered across individual PCs, into the light. It is an open-source style repository where safety managers can library and share their collective know-how.
Beyond mere paperwork, we aim to be a technical bridge that allows anyone to utilise and improve the best safety logic verified in industrial sites nationwide.

item1.desc: We rely on practical JSA templates directly authored and used by field experts, rather than abstract guidelines.

item2.desc: Users can adopt excellent JSA templates by tailoring them for their specific sites, and then contribute those improvements back to the library, raising the overall industry safety standard.

item3.desc: We are building an analysis scenario repository segmented by industry and equipment, including the 9 major high-risk operation categories.

section3.title: How It Works
section3.subtitle: Smart JSA Bridge protects safety through the power of community.

step1.desc: Search the vast repository for a JSA template that matches your current task type.

step2.desc: Select a suitable template and adjust the detailed parameters to fit your work environment.

step3.desc: Print the completed JSA for field application, and share the improved logic back with the community.

step4.desc: Templates that undergo numerous feedback cycles become the 'Golden Standard' for their respective industries.

section4.title: Data Security Philosophy
section4.content:
The value of sharing can only exist upon a foundation of secure privacy.
In accordance with the 'Principle of Non-storage of Sensitive Information', Smart JSA Bridge does not collect identifiable data such as project titles, real names, or specific equipment IDs. We only library the pure technical logic: 'Task-Hazard-Control'.
